Although modern engineering offers an impressive range of methods, certain Roman harbor walls made with volcanic ash have lasted longer than concrete poured within the past century.
Some harbor walls that the Romans built with volcanic ash have proved more durable than certain concrete structures poured within the last hundred years.
Modern engineers have been pouring concrete mixed with volcanic ash for less than a century, and yet some of their harbor walls have already outlasted the ones that the ancient Romans built.

explanation.he: הצירוף **For all** פירושו כאן 'למרות', כלומר החומות הרומיות החזיקו מעמד יותר מבטון חדש אף על פי שההנדסה התקדמה, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על הוויתור במילה **Although** (אף על פי ש-).
explanation.en: **For all** means despite here, so the Roman walls outlasted newer concrete even though engineering has advanced, and the correct answer keeps this with **Although**.

items.stem: The ballad, which a folklorist transcribed in the 1930s from the singing of an itinerant peddler, is now taught in schools by teachers who have never heard it sung.
options: In the 1930s an itinerant peddler transcribed the ballad from the singing of a folklorist, and it is now taught in schools by teachers who have never heard it sung.
Teachers in the 1930s taught the ballad in schools without having heard it sung, and a folklorist is only now writing it down as an itinerant peddler sings it.
The ballad that teachers now sing in schools was transcribed in the 1930s by a folklorist who had never heard a wandering peddler perform it.
A folklorist wrote the ballad down in the 1930s after hearing a traveling peddler sing it, and schoolteachers who have never heard it performed now teach it.

explanation.he: הצירוף **from the singing of an itinerant peddler** אומר שחוקר הפולקלור רשם את מה שהרוכל שר, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על התפקידים ועל הזמנים בצירופים **after hearing** (אחרי ששמע) ו-**now teach** (מלמדים היום).
explanation.en: **From the singing of an itinerant peddler** means the folklorist wrote down the peddler's song, and the correct answer keeps these roles and times.

items.stem: Because caffeine blocks a chemical signal of tiredness that builds up in the brain during waking hours, coffee can keep somnolence at bay for hours without reducing the body's need for rest.
options: By blocking a chemical signal of tiredness that builds up in the brain during waking hours, caffeine lets coffee drinkers stay alert for several hours at a stretch.
Coffee can keep somnolence at bay for hours without reducing the body's need for rest, since caffeine blocks a chemical signal of tiredness that builds up in the brain during sleep.
Caffeine blocks a chemical sign of fatigue that accumulates in the brain while we are awake, so coffee can ward off sleepiness for hours, yet the body needs just as much rest.
Caffeine is itself a chemical signal of tiredness that builds up in the brain during waking hours, so drinking too much coffee can keep the body from getting the rest it needs.

explanation.he: לפי הצירוף **during waking hours** האות מצטבר בזמן שהאדם ער, והקפה אינו מקטין את הצורך במנוחה, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על כך בצירוף **yet the body needs just as much rest** (ובכל זאת הגוף צריך אותה כמות מנוחה).
explanation.en: The signal builds up **during waking hours** and coffee works **without reducing the body's need for rest**, and the correct answer keeps both.

items.stem: Despite its name, the Silk Road, a web of routes linking China with the Mediterranean, carried a plethora of goods besides silk, and few merchants ever traveled its entire length.
options: Named after the silk that made its merchants rich, the web of routes linking China with the Mediterranean carried many other goods as well, and few traders ever traveled its entire length.
Whatever its name suggests, the routes linking China with the Mediterranean known as the Silk Road carried a plethora of goods besides silk, and a good many merchants traveled them from end to end.
Few of the merchants who carried silk along the network of routes linking China with the Mediterranean ever learned how the Silk Road got its name.
Only a handful of merchants ever covered the full length of the Silk Road, a network of routes between China and the Mediterranean that, its name notwithstanding, carried many goods besides silk.

explanation.he: הצירוף **Despite its name** אומר שהדרך נשאה הרבה מלבד משי, והמילה **few** אומרת שמעטים עברו את כל אורכה, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם בצירופים **its name notwithstanding** (למרות שמה) ו-**Only a handful** (רק קומץ).
explanation.en: **Despite its name** and **few merchants** must both survive, and the correct answer keeps them with **its name notwithstanding** and **Only a handful**.

items.stem: Once all but extinct in the wild, the antelope now roams several reserves, though not every herd released into them has survived without the rangers' ministrations.
options: Once all but extinct in the wild, the antelope now roams several reserves, and every herd released into them has survived without the rangers' ministrations.
The antelope, which had nearly vanished from the wild, now lives in several reserves, though some of the herds set free there have been unable to survive without rangers' care.
Having almost died out in the wild, the antelope can now be found in several reserves, but most of the herds released into them have had to rely on the rangers to keep them alive.
Herds of the antelope roamed several reserves until all but a few of them died out, so rangers now care for every herd that is released into the wild.

explanation.he: הצירוף **all but extinct** פירושו כמעט נכחד, והצירוף **not every herd** פירושו שחלק מהעדרים לא שרדו בלי עזרה, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם בצירופים **nearly vanished** ו-**some of the herds**.
explanation.en: **All but extinct** means almost extinct, and **not every herd** means some herds needed help; the correct answer keeps both with **nearly vanished** and **some of the herds**.

items.stem: Were it not for the heat trapped by gases such as water vapor and carbon dioxide, the average temperature at Earth's surface would be well below freezing, a climate inimical to most life.
options: The heat that gases such as water vapor and carbon dioxide trap is what keeps the average temperature at Earth's surface well below freezing, a climate inimical to most life.

If Earth's atmosphere lacked water vapor, carbon dioxide and the other gases that trap heat, its surface would freeze solid from the poles to the equator, and hardly any form of life could survive there.
Gases like water vapor and carbon dioxide trap heat, and without that heat Earth's average surface temperature would drop far below freezing, producing conditions hostile to most life.
Gases such as water vapor and carbon dioxide trap so much heat that the average temperature at Earth's surface stays well above freezing, a climate inimical to most life.

explanation.he: המבנה **Were it not for** פירושו 'אלמלא', כלומר בלי החום שהגזים לוכדים הטמפרטורה הייתה נמוכה בהרבה מנקודת הקיפאון, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על כך בצירוף **without that heat** (בלי החום הזה).
explanation.en: **Were it not for** means without, so the trapped heat keeps Earth from being well below freezing, and the correct answer keeps this with **without that heat**.

items.stem: Much to the chagrin of the professional astronomers who had predicted its return, the comet was first spotted not by any of them but by an amateur with a homemade telescope.
options: An amateur with a homemade telescope sighted the comet before any of the professional astronomers who had forecast its return did, and this greatly annoyed them.
Much to the chagrin of an amateur with a homemade telescope, the comet whose return he had predicted was first spotted by professional astronomers.
The comet was spotted by an amateur with a homemade telescope before the professional astronomers had even predicted its return, which left them deeply embarrassed.
The professional astronomers who had predicted the comet's return were chagrined to learn that an amateur had built a better homemade telescope than any of theirs.

explanation.he: הצירוף **not by any of them but by an amateur** אומר שהחובב ראה את השביט לפני המקצוענים שחזו את חזרתו, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על כך בצירוף **before any of the professional astronomers** (לפני כל אחד מהמקצוענים).
explanation.en: **Not by any of them but by an amateur** means the amateur saw the comet before the professionals who predicted it, and the correct answer keeps these roles.

items.stem: No article in an openly edited online encyclopedia is safe from vandalism, but errors on its most-viewed pages are, as a rule, expunged within minutes, whereas those on obscure pages may linger for months.
options: Although any article in an openly edited online encyclopedia can be vandalized, errors on most of its pages are usually corrected within minutes, whereas those on obscure pages may linger for months.

Vandalism can strike any of the articles in an openly edited online encyclopedia, and although errors on its most-viewed pages are quickly expunged, its obscure pages are riddled with mistakes that linger for months on end.
Vandals who target the most-viewed pages of an openly edited online encyclopedia are, as a rule, caught within minutes, whereas those who target obscure pages may go unnoticed for months.

Any article in a freely editable online encyclopedia may be vandalized; still, mistakes on the pages people read most are usually removed within minutes, while those on little-known pages can stay for months.

explanation.he: הצירוף **its most-viewed pages** מגביל את התיקון המהיר לדפים הנצפים ביותר והמילה **may** מסייגת, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם בצירופים **the pages people read most** ו-**can stay** (עלולות להישאר).
explanation.en: **Its most-viewed pages** limits the quick fixes and **may** hedges the delay, and the correct answer keeps both with **the pages people read most** and **can stay**.

items.stem: Unable to write down every word, students who take lecture notes by hand must reduce what they hear to pithy summaries, which may help them remember the material better than classmates who type.
options: Students who take lecture notes by hand remember the material better than classmates who type, which might be why they can reduce what they hear to pithy summaries instead of writing down every word.
Students who handwrite their lecture notes cannot record everything that is said, so they have to sum it up briefly, and this might give them an advantage in recall over classmates using a keyboard.
Unable to write down every word, students who take lecture notes by hand must reduce what they hear to pithy summaries, which makes them remember the material far better than classmates who type.
Classmates who type their lecture notes can write down every word, so they remember the material better than students who must boil what they hear down to short summaries by hand.

explanation.he: הצירוף **Unable to write down every word** הוא הסיבה לסיכום והמילה **may** מסייגת את היתרון, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם בצירופים **so they have to sum it up** ו-**might give them an advantage** (עשוי לתת להם יתרון).
explanation.en: **Unable to write down every word** gives the cause of the summaries and **may** hedges the memory gain, and the correct answer keeps both with **so** and **might**.

items.stem: Far fewer onlookers notice a sartorial blunder than the person who made it tends to imagine, though it would be rash to conclude that such a blunder goes entirely unnoticed.
options: Those who make a fashion mistake usually think many more people see it than really do, but it would be unwise to assume that nobody sees it.
Usually only a handful of onlookers notice a sartorial blunder, though it would be rash to claim that it passes entirely unnoticed.
Onlookers notice a blunder in someone's clothing far less often than the person who made it tends to fear, and it would be rash to assume that anyone notices it.
People who commit a sartorial blunder tend to imagine that far fewer onlookers notice it than actually do, though it would be rash to say it goes entirely unnoticed.

explanation.he: הצירוף **Far fewer ... than ... tends to imagine** אומר שמי שטעה מגזים בהערכה, והאזהרה **rash to conclude ... entirely unnoticed** אומרת שיש רואים, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם בצירוף **many more ... than really do**.
explanation.en: **Far fewer ... than ... tends to imagine** means the wearer overestimates, and **rash to conclude ... entirely unnoticed** means some do notice; the correct answer keeps both.

items.stem: Ben forgot his keys, so he could not ________ the front door.
options: wash
carry
open
paint

explanation.he: הצירוף **forgot his keys** (שכח את המפתחות) מראה שבן לא יכול היה להיכנס, ולכן המילה החסרה היא **open** (לפתוח).
explanation.en: **Forgot his keys** is the cause, and **so** gives the result: without keys, Ben could not **open** the front door.

items.stem: My sister likes loud music, but I like ________ music.
options: quiet
cheap
funny
famous

explanation.he: המילה **but** (אבל) מסמנת ניגוד ל-**loud music** (מוזיקה רועשת), ולכן הדובר אוהב מוזיקה **quiet** (שקטה).
explanation.en: **But** signals a contrast with **loud music**, so the speaker likes **quiet** (not loud) music.

items.stem: Doctors say we should avoid ________ drinks, such as cola, because they contain a lot of sugar.
options: thick
useful
cold
sweet

explanation.he: הדוגמה **such as cola** (כמו קולה) והסיבה **a lot of sugar** (הרבה סוכר) מראות שהרופאים מזהירים ממשקאות **sweet** (מתוקים).
explanation.en: The example **such as cola** and the reason **a lot of sugar** show that doctors warn against **sweet** drinks.

items.stem: Josh broke the window, but he decided to tell his teacher the ________.
options: joke
truth
dream
lie

explanation.he: המילה **but** (אבל) מסמנת ניגוד לשבירת החלון (**broke the window**), והצירוף הקבוע **tell the truth** (לומר את האמת) הוא מה שג'וש החליט לעשות.
explanation.en: **But** contrasts with **broke the window**, and the fixed phrase is to **tell the truth**.

items.stem: The market was so ________ on Saturday that it was hard to walk between the tables.
options: clean
familiar
crowded
colorful

explanation.he: המבנה **so ... that** (כל כך ש...) מראה שהתוצאה, **hard to walk between the tables** (קשה ללכת בין השולחנות), נובעת מכך שהשוק היה **crowded** (צפוף).
explanation.en: The pattern **so ... that** gives a result, **hard to walk between the tables**, that comes from a **crowded** market.

items.stem: Although days in the desert are dry and extremely hot, the nights can be surprisingly ________.
options: calm
scorching
dusty
chilly

explanation.he: המילה **Although** (למרות ש...) מסמנת ניגוד לימים החמים מאוד (**extremely hot**), ולכן הלילות הם באופן מפתיע **chilly** (קרירים).
explanation.en: **Although** signals a contrast with the **extremely hot** days, so the nights are surprisingly **chilly** (cold).

items.stem: The new teacher was very ________: she explained each idea several times, and she never lost her temper when students asked the same question again.
options: strict
patient
honest
creative

explanation.he: הנקודתיים מסבירים את המילה החסרה: מורה שמסבירה כל רעיון כמה פעמים ואינה כועסת (**never lost her temper**) היא **patient** (סבלנית).
explanation.en: The colon explains the blank: a teacher who explains ideas several times and **never lost her temper** is **patient**.

items.stem: Because the instructions were so ________, many customers could not build the bookshelf and called the shop for help.
options: confusing
polite
convenient
attractive

explanation.he: המילה **Because** (כי) והתוצאה **could not build the bookshelf** (לא הצליחו להרכיב את הכוננית) מראות שההוראות היו **confusing** (מבלבלות).
explanation.en: **Because** introduces a cause, and the result, **could not build the bookshelf**, shows that the instructions were **confusing**.

items.stem: Unless the weather becomes ________ before Friday afternoon, the school festival will take place outdoors as planned.
options: severe
dry
warm
pleasant

explanation.he: המילה **Unless** (אלא אם כן) מראה שהתוכנית לקיים את הפסטיבל בחוץ (**outdoors as planned**) תשתנה רק אם מזג האוויר יהיה **severe** (קשה, חמור).
explanation.en: **Unless** means 'if not': the festival stays **outdoors as planned** unless the weather becomes **severe** (very bad).

items.stem: Although the first version of the software was praised for its speed, users soon found it ________: it crashed whenever they opened more than three files at once.
options: complex
unreliable
efficient
unnecessary

explanation.he: המילה **Although** (למרות ש...) מסמנת ניגוד לשבחים על המהירות, והסבר הקריסות (**it crashed**) מראה שהתוכנה **unreliable** (לא אמינה).
explanation.en: **Although** contrasts the praise for speed with a problem, and **it crashed** shows the software was **unreliable** (not dependable).

items.stem: Despite being drawn with great care by a skilled artist, the map was ________ in many details: rivers appeared in the wrong places and two of the towns did not exist.
options: precise
decorative
inaccurate
detailed

explanation.he: המילה **Despite** (למרות) מסמנת ניגוד לציור הקפדני (**with great care**), וההסבר אחרי הנקודתיים (**in the wrong places**) מראה שהמפה הייתה **inaccurate** (לא מדויקת).
explanation.en: **Despite** contrasts the great care with the errors, and **in the wrong places** shows the map was **inaccurate** (not correct).

items.stem: While her novels sell millions of copies every year, the author herself is famously ________: she rarely gives interviews and avoids public events.
options: wealthy
garrulous
talented
reclusive

explanation.he: הנקודתיים מסבירים את המילה החסרה: מי שכמעט אינה נותנת ראיונות ונמנעת מאירועים ציבוריים (**rarely gives interviews and avoids public events**) היא **reclusive** (מתבודדת).
explanation.en: The colon explains the blank: someone who **rarely gives interviews and avoids public events** is **reclusive** (keeps away from people).

items.stem: Although the patient looked perfectly healthy, he had to ________ several tests before the doctors allowed him to leave the hospital.
options: deliver
undergo
request
resolve

explanation.he: הצירוף הקבוע **undergo tests** (לעבור בדיקות) מתאים למטופל שנבדק לפני שהרופאים מתירים לו ללכת (**before the doctors allowed him to leave**).
explanation.en: The fixed phrase is **undergo tests**: a patient is examined **before the doctors allowed him to leave** the hospital.

items.stem: Although news reports tend to focus on sudden disasters, many environmental hazards, such as slow poisoning from polluted water or years of lung damage from dust, are ________ and therefore easy to overlook.
options: dramatic
accidental
gradual
beneficial

explanation.he: הדוגמאות **slow poisoning** ו-**years of lung damage** מתארות נזק איטי, והמילה **Although** מנגידה אותו לאסונות פתאומיים (**sudden disasters**), ולכן הסכנות הן **gradual** (הדרגתיות).
explanation.en: The examples **slow poisoning** and **years of lung damage** describe slow harm, which **Although** contrasts with **sudden disasters**, so the hazards are **gradual**.

items.stem: Although the manager's speech was ________, listing every complaint in detail, it offered no practical way to solve any of them.
options: thorough
constructive
vague
brief

explanation.he: הצירוף **listing every complaint in detail** (רישום מפורט של כל תלונה) מתאר נאום **thorough** (יסודי), והמילה **Although** מנגידה אותו לחוסר פתרון מעשי.
explanation.en: **Listing every complaint in detail** describes a **thorough** speech, and **Although** contrasts it with the lack of a practical solution.

items.stem: Although donations to the animal shelter rose sharply after its televised appeal, they soon began to ________, and within a year the monthly total was smaller than it had been before the broadcast.
options: plateau
burgeon
accrue
dwindle

explanation.he: המילה **Although** מסמנת ניגוד לעלייה החדה, והסוף **smaller than it had been before the broadcast** מראה ירידה של ממש, ולכן התשובה היא **dwindle** (להצטמצם, להתמעט).
explanation.en: **Although** contrasts with the sharp rise, and **smaller than it had been before the broadcast** shows a real decline, so the answer is **dwindle** (shrink gradually).

items.stem: After a decade without a serious flood, residents of the bucolic river valley had grown ________, leaving drainage channels uncleared and sandbags rotting in storage, so last spring's storm caught them almost entirely unprepared.
options: resigned
lax
vigilant
prosperous

explanation.he: עשור בלי שיטפון (**After a decade without a serious flood**) הוביל להזנחה (**leaving drainage channels uncleared**), ולכן התשובה היא **lax** (רשלני, לא מקפיד).
explanation.en: A decade with no flood led to **drainage channels uncleared** and an unprepared town, so residents had grown **lax** (careless about precautions).

items.stem: Doctors advise against flying, however propitious the timing, until a patient's fever has begun to ________, that is, until the temperature has stayed below 38 degrees Celsius for a full day.
options: linger
spike
abate
fluctuate

explanation.he: הצירוף **that is** מסביר שהחום נשאר מתחת ל-38 מעלות יממה שלמה (**stayed below 38 degrees Celsius for a full day**), ולכן התשובה היא **abate** (לשכוך, להיחלש).
explanation.en: **That is** explains the blank: the temperature **stayed below 38 degrees Celsius for a full day**, so the fever has begun to **abate** (become less strong).

items.stem: Small farmers who grow ________ crops, such as strawberries, lettuce and fresh herbs, must sell them within days of the harvest and therefore have little power to hold out for a better price.
options: perishable
seasonal
verdant
subsidized

explanation.he: הדוגמאות (**strawberries, lettuce and fresh herbs**) והחובה למכור בתוך ימים (**must sell them within days of the harvest**) מצביעות על יבול שמתקלקל מהר, ולכן התשובה היא **perishable** (מתכלה).
explanation.en: The examples and **must sell them within days of the harvest** point to crops that spoil fast, so the answer is **perishable** (likely to go bad quickly).

items.stem: When the school trip was canceled, a clause buried in the contract's turgid small print meant that the tour operator, not the parents, had to ________ the bill for the unused hotel rooms.
options: split
dodge
pass
foot

explanation.he: הצירוף הקבוע **foot the bill** (לשאת בתשלום) מתאים לחובה שהסעיף הטיל (**had to**) על צד אחד בלבד (**the tour operator, not the parents**), ולכן התשובה היא **foot**.
explanation.en: **Foot the bill** means pay it, and the clause made one side pay alone, **the tour operator, not the parents**, so the answer is **foot**.

items.stem: Amid the welter of events at the university's open day, three introductory lectures are ________, so visitors must choose between biology, history and economics, all of which begin at ten o'clock.
options: concurrent
concordant
contiguous
discursive

explanation.he: החלקים **con** (יחד) ו-**cur** (לרוץ) נותנים 'רצים יחד', כמו בהסבר **all of which begin at ten o'clock**, ולכן התשובה היא **concurrent** (מתקיים בו-זמנית).
explanation.en: **Con** (together) plus **cur** (run) gives 'running together', which matches **all of which begin at ten o'clock**, so the answer is **concurrent**.

items.stem: Heavy snow did not stop the town's intrepid delivery drivers, but it did ________ their progress, so that a route that usually takes an hour took nearly five.
options: halt
hamper
chart
expedite

explanation.he: הצירופים **did not stop** ו-**but it did** אומרים שהשלג לא עצר אבל כן הפריע, והתוצאה **took nearly five** מראה האטה, ולכן התשובה היא **hamper** (לעכב, להכביד).
explanation.en: The snow **did not stop** the drivers, **but it did** slow them (**took nearly five**), so the answer is **hamper** (make progress slow and difficult).

items.stem: Sailors long regarded a ring around the moon as a ________ of storms: the ring itself does nothing to stir up the wind, but it often appears a day or so before bad weather arrives.
options: catalyst
remnant
harbinger
consequence

explanation.he: הטבעת אינה גורמת לרוח (**does nothing to stir up the wind**) אבל מופיעה לפני מזג האוויר הרע (**before bad weather arrives**), ולכן התשובה היא **harbinger** (מבשר, סימן מקדים).
explanation.en: The ring **does nothing to stir up the wind** yet comes **before bad weather arrives**, so it is a **harbinger** (an early sign of something coming).

items.stem: Far from being the ________ genius of later legend, the composer kept meticulous accounts, answered every letter within a week and rarely missed a rehearsal.
options: tormented
impecunious
feckless
unkempt

explanation.he: המבנה **Far from being** דורש את ההפך מן הפרטים שבהמשך, ומי שניהל חשבונות בקפדנות וענה לכל מכתב (**kept meticulous accounts, answered every letter**) היה אחראי, ולכן התשובה היא **feckless** (חסר אחריות).
explanation.en: **Far from being** demands the opposite of someone who **kept meticulous accounts, answered every letter**, so the answer is **feckless** (irresponsible and disorganized).

items.stem: The popular claim that people use only ten percent of their brains is not a scientific finding but a ________: a baseless story repeated so often that many accept it without question.
options: canard
misnomer
truism
platitude

explanation.he: ההסבר שאחרי הנקודתיים מגדיר את החסר כסיפור חסר בסיס שחוזר שוב ושוב (**a baseless story repeated so often**), ולכן התשובה היא **canard** (שמועת שווא, בדותה).
explanation.en: The colon defines the blank as **a baseless story repeated so often** that people believe it, so the answer is **canard** (a false, widely spread story).

items.stem: Even Victorian novels praised for their verisimilitude rely heavily on ________: the long-lost heir who turns up in the final chapter, for example, or the letter that arrives at exactly the moment the plot requires.
options: foreshadowing
contrivance
allegory
satire

explanation.he: הדוגמאות, כמו מכתב שמגיע בדיוק כשהעלילה צריכה אותו (**exactly the moment the plot requires**), הן פתרונות מאולצים, ולכן התשובה היא **contrivance** (תחבולה מלאכותית).
explanation.en: The examples, like a letter arriving at **exactly the moment the plot requires**, are artificial devices, so the answer is **contrivance** (an obviously planned, unnatural device).

items.stem: Plans for a second runway have been in ________ since the airline that was to use it went bankrupt: they remain unchanged and uncanceled, but no work will start until a new tenant is found.
options: arrears
perpetuity
flux
abeyance

explanation.he: הצירוף הקבוע **in abeyance** (מוקפא, מושהה זמנית) מתאים לתוכניות שלא בוטלו (**unchanged and uncanceled**) אבל מחכות (**until a new tenant is found**), ולכן התשובה היא **abeyance**.
explanation.en: **In abeyance** means suspended for now, matching plans that remain **unchanged and uncanceled** but wait **until a new tenant is found**.

items.stem: Teachers once dismissed disruptive pupils as ________, convinced that no amount of discipline or advice would change their conduct, yet later studies found that most embraced real responsibility with alacrity.
options: infallible
insolvent
incorrigible
incorruptible

explanation.he: החלקים **in** (לא), **corrig** (לתקן) ו-**ible** (ניתן) נותנים 'שאי אפשר לתקן', כמו בהסבר **no amount of discipline or advice would change their conduct**, ולכן התשובה היא **incorrigible** (חסר תקנה).
explanation.en: **In** (not) + **corrig** (correct) + **ible** (able) gives 'cannot be corrected', matching **no amount of discipline or advice would change their conduct**, so the answer is **incorrigible**.

items.stem: The village's sleepy appearance, all shuttered cottages and torpid cats, ________ its history: for nearly three centuries it was the busiest port on the coast, crowded with ships from a dozen countries.
options: betrays
presages
embodies
belies

explanation.he: המראה המנומנם (**sleepy appearance**) סותר את העבר כנמל העמוס ביותר בחוף (**the busiest port on the coast**), ולכן התשובה היא **belies** (נותן רושם כוזב).
explanation.en: A **sleepy appearance** gives a false picture of **the busiest port on the coast**, so the answer is **belies** (gives a false impression of).

items.stem: The philosopher was ________ rather than ascetic: he drank a single glass of wine with dinner and ate sparingly, but he never denied himself the pleasures of good company, music or travel.
options: abstemious
sybaritic
abstinent
puritanical

explanation.he: כוס יין אחת ואכילה במשורה (**a single glass of wine with dinner and ate sparingly**) מראות מתינות ולא התנזרות, ולכן התשובה היא **abstemious** (מתון באכילה ובשתייה).
explanation.en: Drinking **a single glass of wine** and eating **sparingly** shows moderation, not total refusal, so the answer is **abstemious** (moderate in eating and drinking).

items.stem: It was a very hot day, so we went to the ________ and swam all afternoon.
options: kitchen
station
pool
garage

explanation.he: הפועל **swam** (שחינו) מראה שהלכו למקום שבו אפשר לשחות, ולכן המילה החסרה היא **pool** (בריכה).
explanation.en: The word **swam** shows they went to a place for swimming on a **very hot day**, so the answer is **pool** (a place built for swimming).

items.stem: Our new neighbor is very ________; she smiles and says hello to everyone.
options: noisy
hungry
terrible
friendly

explanation.he: ההסבר שאחרי הנקודה-פסיק, **she smiles and says hello to everyone**, מתאר אדם נחמד, ולכן המילה החסרה היא **friendly** (ידידותית).
explanation.en: What follows the semicolon, **she smiles and says hello to everyone**, explains the blank, so the neighbor is **friendly** (kind and open to people).

items.stem: Rita was ________ for school today because her bus broke down on the way.
options: late
sorry
proud
afraid

explanation.he: המילה **because** (כי) מסבירה את התוצאה: האוטובוס התקלקל בדרך (**her bus broke down on the way**), ולכן ריטה הגיעה באיחור, **late** (מאחרת), לבית הספר.
explanation.en: The word **because** links the result to its cause: **her bus broke down on the way**, so Rita was **late** (not on time) for school.

items.stem: If you walk in the rain without a coat, you may ________ a cold.
options: hold
catch
throw
pull

explanation.he: הצירוף הקבוע **catch a cold** (להצטנן) הוא היחיד שמתאים לשם העצם **a cold**, וההליכה בגשם בלי מעיל (**walk in the rain without a coat**) מסבירה למה זה קורה.
explanation.en: The fixed phrase **catch a cold** (to become ill with a cold) fits **a cold**, and walking **in the rain without a coat** explains why it can happen.

items.stem: Some chemicals are ________; for example, strong cleaning liquids can burn the skin.
options: harmful
important
natural
invisible

explanation.he: הצירוף **for example** (למשל) מביא דוגמה: נוזלי ניקוי חזקים יכולים לשרוף את העור (**can burn the skin**), ולכן המילה החסרה היא **harmful** (מזיק).
explanation.en: **For example** introduces an instance: strong cleaning liquids **can burn the skin**, so some chemicals are **harmful** (able to hurt people).

items.stem: Even though Carlos had studied English for only one year, his speaking was already ________, and many visitors thought he was a native speaker.
options: hesitant
formal
fluent
local

explanation.he: הצירוף **Even though** (אף על פי ש) מעמיד את שנת הלימוד היחידה (**only one year**) מול התוצאה, ולכן הדיבור של קרלוס היה כבר **fluent** (שוטף), עד שחשבו שהוא דובר שפת אם.
explanation.en: **Even though** he had studied for **only one year**, his speaking was already **fluent** (smooth and easy), so visitors thought he was a **native speaker**.

items.stem: The rule was ________ because it allowed only some students to enter the competition.
options: unclear
unsafe
unknown
unfair

explanation.he: המילה **because** (כי) מסבירה מה הבעיה בכלל: הוא איפשר רק לחלק מהתלמידים להשתתף (**allowed only some students**), ולכן הוא **unfair** (לא הוגן).
explanation.en: Because the rule **allowed only some students** to enter, it treated people differently, so it was **unfair**: **un-** means not, and **fair** means equal and just.

items.stem: Whereas a cup of strong coffee keeps most people awake, a warm bath in the evening often makes them feel ________.
options: energetic
sleepy
thirsty
cheerful

explanation.he: המילה **Whereas** (ואילו) מציבה את הרחצה החמה מול הקפה שמעיר אנשים (**keeps most people awake**), ולכן היא גורמת להם להרגיש **sleepy** (מנומנמים).
explanation.en: **Whereas** sets the warm bath against coffee that **keeps most people awake**, so the bath makes them feel **sleepy** (ready for sleep).

items.stem: Students who study in a ________ place, such as a quiet library, usually remember more than those who study next to a loud television.
options: modern
unfamiliar
peaceful
private

explanation.he: הצירוף **such as** (כמו) מביא דוגמה, ספרייה שקטה (**a quiet library**), והמשפט מעמיד אותה מול טלוויזיה רועשת, ולכן המילה החסרה היא **peaceful** (שליו, שקט).
explanation.en: **Such as** gives an example, **a quiet library**, set against a **loud television**, so the blank means **peaceful** (quiet and calm).

items.stem: Although the school committee was ________ to change its old timetable, a flood of complaints from parents finally persuaded its members to try a new one.
options: reluctant
eager
powerless
qualified

explanation.he: הצירוף **Although** (למרות ש) והמילה **finally** (לבסוף) מראים שהוועדה התנגדה בתחילה והתלונות שיכנעו אותה (**finally persuaded**), ולכן המילה החסרה היא **reluctant** (לא ששה, חסרת רצון).
explanation.en: **Although** and **finally persuaded** show that the committee first resisted change, so it was **reluctant** (unwilling) to change its timetable.

items.stem: Although the experiment was carried out with great care, it produced ________ results: when repeated three times, it gave a different answer every time.
options: accurate
satisfactory
encouraging
inconsistent

explanation.he: הנקודתיים מסבירים את החסר: כשחזרו על הניסוי התקבלה בכל פעם תשובה שונה (**a different answer every time**), ולכן התוצאות היו **inconsistent** (לא עקביות), למרות הזהירות הרבה.
explanation.en: The colon explains the blank: repeating it gave **a different answer every time**, so despite the great care (**Although**) the results were **inconsistent** (not the same).

items.stem: Although the two companies had disagreed about prices for months, they finally ________ an agreement after one last night of talks.
options: broke
reached
rejected
threw

explanation.he: שם העצם **an agreement** קובע את הצירוף הקבוע **reach an agreement** (להגיע להסכמה), והצירוף **Although** עם **finally** מראה שאחרי חודשי ויכוח (**disagreed about prices for months**) הגיעו להסכמה.
explanation.en: **Reach an agreement** is a fixed phrase, and **Although** with **finally** shows that after months of disagreement the companies at last **reached** one.

items.stem: Although the earliest electric buses could run for only an hour between charges, ________ models, built over the next ten years, managed a full day.
options: original
occasional
previous
subsequent

explanation.he: הצירוף **built over the next ten years** מראה שהדגמים נבנו אחרי הראשונים, ולכן המילה החסרה היא **subsequent** (מאוחרים יותר), והצירוף **Although** מעמיד את הדגמים האלה מול האוטובוסים הראשונים.
explanation.en: **Built over the next ten years** shows these models came after the earliest ones, so the blank is **subsequent** (coming later), which **Although** contrasts with **the earliest** buses.

items.stem: Although many people believe that a large vocabulary makes someone a good writer, great authors often use ________ words, choosing the simplest term that expresses their meaning.
options: florid
foreign
ordinary
scientific

explanation.he: הצירוף **Although** (למרות ש) מציג אמונה נפוצה על אוצר מילים גדול, וההמשך, **choosing the simplest term**, מראה שסופרים גדולים משתמשים במילים פשוטות, ולכן המילה החסרה היא **ordinary** (רגילות).
explanation.en: **Although** introduces a common belief about a large vocabulary, and **choosing the simplest term** shows that great authors use **ordinary** (everyday) words.

items.stem: Although many trees, such as oaks and maples, lose all their leaves each autumn, others, such as pines and firs, are ________.
options: deciduous
evergreen
tropical
ancient

explanation.he: הצירוף **such as** (כמו) נותן דוגמאות לעצים שמאבדים את עליהם (**oaks and maples**), והמילה **others** מעמידה מולם עצים אחרים, **pines and firs**, ולכן המילה החסרה היא **evergreen** (ירוקי עד).
explanation.en: **Such as** gives examples of trees that **lose all their leaves**, and **others** sets different trees against them, so pines and firs are **evergreen** (they keep their leaves).

items.stem: Because the signal from the probe, now far beyond Pluto, was ________, arriving in brief bursts separated by long stretches of silence, the mission's dogged engineers needed weeks to piece together a single image.
options: faint
intermittent
uninterrupted
distorted

explanation.he: הצירוף שאחרי החסר מתאר אות שמגיע בפרצים קצרים עם שתיקות ארוכות ביניהם (**brief bursts separated by long stretches of silence**), ולכן התשובה היא **intermittent** (לסירוגין, מקוטע).
explanation.en: A signal **arriving in brief bursts separated by long stretches of silence** keeps stopping and starting, so it is **intermittent** (on and off).

items.stem: Unlike its predecessor, which fined shops heavily for every peccadillo, the new consumer agency is relatively ________, preferring warnings to fines; yet it is not careless: it inspects every store twice a year.
options: remiss
draconian
impartial
lenient

explanation.he: המילה **Unlike** מציבה את הסוכנות מול קודמתה, שקנסה בכבדות, והיא מעדיפה אזהרות (**preferring warnings to fines**) אך אינה רשלנית, ולכן התשובה היא **lenient** (מקל, סלחני).
explanation.en: **Unlike** a predecessor that fined heavily, the agency prefers **warnings to fines** yet **is not careless**, so it is **lenient** (mild in punishing).

items.stem: For the impoverished mountain village, the sale of a rocky hillside it had long considered worthless was a genuine ________, an unexpected fortune that paid for a new school and a clinic.
options: windfall
royalty
bequest
endowment

explanation.he: הצירוף שאחרי החסר מגדיר אותו כהון לא צפוי (**an unexpected fortune**) ממכירת אדמה שנחשבה חסרת ערך, ולכן התשובה היא **windfall** (רווח פתאומי ובלתי צפוי).
explanation.en: The phrase **an unexpected fortune**, from land the village had **long considered worthless**, defines a **windfall** (a sudden, unexpected gain).

items.stem: Although ________ technologies such as the pager and the fax machine have all but vanished from most offices, many hospitals keep them as stalwart backups for when the network fails.
options: wireless
bulky
obsolete
cutting-edge

explanation.he: הדוגמאות **the pager and the fax machine** הן מכשירים ישנים שכמעט נעלמו מן המשרדים (**have all but vanished**), ולכן התשובה היא **obsolete** (מיושן, שעבר זמנו).
explanation.en: The examples **the pager and the fax machine**, which **have all but vanished from most offices**, are **obsolete** (out of date) technologies.

items.stem: Delays of an hour or more are ________ for the course on the island's ramshackle single-track railway, so locals rarely complain and simply bring a book.
options: matter
obstacle
par
collision

explanation.he: המילים **for the course** והעובדה שהתושבים כמעט אינם מתלוננים (**locals rarely complain**) מובילות לביטוי **par for the course** (דבר רגיל וצפוי), ולכן התשובה היא **par**.
explanation.en: **For the course** and **locals rarely complain** point to the idiom **par for the course** (normal and expected), so the answer is **par**.

items.stem: The poet won no prizes and sold few books during her lifetime; her fame was entirely ________, arriving only decades after her death, when a scholar found her notebooks moldering in an attic.
options: posthumous
premature
postnatal
pseudonymous

explanation.he: התהילה הגיעה רק עשרות שנים אחרי מות המשוררת (**arriving only decades after her death**), ולכן התשובה היא **posthumous** (שלאחר המוות), עם התחילית **post-** (אחרי).
explanation.en: Fame **arriving only decades after her death** is **posthumous** (coming after death); **post-** means 'after'.

items.stem: Rather than banning skateboards outright and facing a deluge of complaints, the town fitted its benches and low walls with small metal studs, which ________ skaters without preventing anyone from sitting down.
options: prohibit
deter
lure
reprimand

explanation.he: הבליטות באות במקום איסור (**Rather than banning**) ואינן מונעות מאיש לשבת (**without preventing anyone from sitting down**), ולכן התשובה היא **deter** (להרתיע).
explanation.en: The studs work **Rather than banning** and **without preventing anyone from sitting down**, so they **deter** (discourage) skaters.

items.stem: In the 1830s the art of photography was still ________: a single portrait demanded minutes of perfect stillness, and few people yet imagined that it might one day rival painting.
options: imitative
outmoded
tedious
nascent

explanation.he: המילים **still** ו-**yet** וההסבר שאחרי הנקודתיים מתארים אמנות בתחילת דרכה, עם חשיפות ארוכות ועתיד שעוד לא נראה, ולכן התשובה היא **nascent** (מתהווה, בראשית דרכו).
explanation.en: **Still**, **yet** and the details after the colon describe an art just beginning, so photography was **nascent** (newly forming).

items.stem: On the eve of the competition final, the young pianist seemed almost ________ — not reckless, for she had practiced every piece for months, but untroubled, chatting with friends while her rivals paced the corridor.
options: foolhardy
indolent
despondent
insouciant

explanation.he: המבנה **not reckless ... but untroubled** מגדיר את החסר כשלווה חסרת דאגה של מי שהתכוננה היטב, ולכן התשובה היא **insouciant** (שליו וחסר דאגה, קליל).
explanation.en: The frame **not reckless ... but untroubled** describes calm, carefree ease, so she seemed **insouciant** (relaxed and unconcerned).

items.stem: The medieval town's rapacious growth all but ________ its Roman core: its houses were torn down for their stone, and only some paving beneath a few cellars survives.
options: obliterated
enshrined
encompassed
dwarfed

explanation.he: הצירוף **all but** פירושו כמעט לגמרי, ורק מעט ריצוף שרד (**only some paving beneath a few cellars survives**), ולכן התשובה היא **obliterated** (נמחה, הושמד כליל).
explanation.en: The phrase **all but** means almost completely, and **only some paving beneath a few cellars survives**, so the core was almost entirely **obliterated** (destroyed).

items.stem: Though often handsome, with grand town halls, nineteenth-century factory towns were notoriously ________ places to live, with conditions such as coal smoke, open sewers and drinking water drawn from polluted rivers.
options: unprepossessing
unwholesome
idyllic
provincial

explanation.he: הדוגמאות שאחרי הצירוף **such as**, עשן פחם, ביוב פתוח ומי שתייה ממקור מזוהם, הן כולן סכנות לבריאות, ולכן התשובה היא **unwholesome** (לא בריא, מזיק לבריאות).
explanation.en: The examples after **such as** (**coal smoke, open sewers and drinking water drawn from polluted rivers**) all harm health, so the towns were **unwholesome** (unhealthy).

items.stem: Cheap smartphones brought about a ________ change in how travelers find their way: within a decade, the folding paper map, once a fixture of every glove box, had become a mere curio.
options: cosmetic
loose
sea
climate

explanation.he: שינוי שבתוך עשור הפך את מפת הנייר לחפץ נדיר (**had become a mere curio**) הוא **a sea change** (שינוי עמוק ויסודי), ולכן התשובה היא **sea**.
explanation.en: A change that, **within a decade**, turned the paper map into **a mere curio** is **a sea change** (a deep, complete transformation), so the answer is **sea**.

items.stem: Although the novel's narrator is a lugubrious village doctor speaking in the first person, she is curiously ________, reporting the private thoughts of strangers and knowing how each of their lives will end.
options: omnipresent
omniscient
omnivorous
omnipotent

explanation.he: היא מדווחת על מחשבות של זרים ויודעת איך יסתיימו חייהם (**knowing how each of their lives will end**), כלומר יודעת הכול, ולכן התשובה היא **omniscient** (יודע-כל: **omni-** = כל, **sci** = לדעת).
explanation.en: Reporting **the private thoughts of strangers** and **knowing how each of their lives will end** means knowing everything: **omniscient** (all-knowing).

items.stem: A good referee, however vociferous the home crowd, must be ________: she may care deeply about the sport itself, but she must have no stake in which team wins.
options: uninterested
unflappable
self-interested
disinterested

explanation.he: לפי ההסבר שאחרי הנקודתיים, מותר לה לאהוב את הספורט, אבל אסור שיהיה לה אינטרס בתוצאה (**no stake in which team wins**), ולכן התשובה היא **disinterested** (חסר פניות, ללא אינטרס אישי).
explanation.en: She **may care deeply about the sport itself** but must have **no stake in which team wins**, so she must be **disinterested** (impartial, with no personal interest).

items.stem: Even the historian's most persistent critics offered ________ praise for her new edition of the chronicle: they still disputed her conclusions, but conceded that no one had ever assembled the evidence so carefully.
options: fulsome
obligatory
grudging
belated

explanation.he: המבקרים עדיין חלקו על מסקנותיה אבל הודו (**still disputed her conclusions, but conceded**) שאיש לא אסף ראיות בקפידה כזאת, ולכן התשובה היא **grudging** (שניתן בחצי פה, בחוסר רצון).
explanation.en: Critics who **still disputed her conclusions, but conceded** her care give praise unwillingly, so it was **grudging** (given reluctantly).
